title: Before AI Agents Negotiate for Us: A Competitive Tournament of Rule-Based, Search, Optimization, Learned, and Language-Model Negotiators Under Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2611.15838v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated bilateral negotiation underlies two-sided matching markets such as freight brokering, where many shippers and carriers negotiate price before a matching mechanism decides who is paired with whom. Prior strategy comparisons typically use isolated one-on-one duels or a single fixed market, so they cannot show how a strategy behaves against several live rivals under a changing balance of supply and demand. We built nine negotiation architectures spanning rule-based, search-based, optimization-based, imitation-learning, and reinforcement-learning families, and ran all nine simultaneously on both sides of a Gale-Shapley matching market under a balanced condition and two scarcity conditions rotated across all 36 exclusion pairs. translated_title: 在AI智能体为我们谈判之前：稀缺条件下基于规则、搜索、优化、学习与语言模型的谈判智能体竞争锦标赛
translated_abstract: 自动化双边谈判是货运经纪等双边匹配市场的基础，在这些市场中，众多货主与承运商先就价格进行谈判，然后由匹配机制决定双方的配对。以往的策略比较通常采用孤立的一对一对决或单一固定市场，因此无法揭示一种策略在不断变化的供需平衡下如何应对多个实时对手。我们构建了九种谈判架构，涵盖基于规则、基于搜索、基于优化、模仿学习和强化学习等家族，并在平衡条件和两种稀缺条件下，将这九种架构同时部署在Gale-Shapley匹配市场的两侧，在全部36个排除配对中轮换进行实验。在平衡的承运商市场中，一个模仿学习引擎（ML2）、一个仅在孤立谈判中训练的强化学习策略（RL）和一个期望效用优化引擎（OPT）形成了统计上显著的第一梯队……
tldr: 该论文构建了九种涵盖规则、搜索、优化、模仿学习和强化学习的谈判AI架构，让它们在Gale-Shapley匹配市场的平衡与稀缺供需条件下同场竞技，首次揭示了各谈判策略在多实时对手、动态市场环境中的真实竞争力。
en_tdlr: This paper built nine negotiation AI architectures spanning rule-based, search-based, optimization-based, imitation-learning, and reinforcement-learning families, and ran them simultaneously on both sides of a Gale-Shapley matching market under balanced and scarce supply-demand conditions, revealing for the first time how negotiation strategies perform against multiple live rivals in dynamic markets.
